title: Critical-Exponent Polyharmonic Dirichlet Problems
statement: Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be bounded and conformally contractible, with $n>2m$. Does the small-$\lambda$ uniqueness result for $(-\Delta)^m u=\lambda(1+|u|^{p-1}u)$ with boundary conditions $u=\nabla u=\cdots=D^{m-1}u=0$ extend from $p>(n+2m)/(n-2m)$ to the critical exponent $p=(n+2m)/(n-2m)$?
